title: Emit ACP SSE mission events live
goal: Replace the buffered ACP SSE response path with a bounded callback-backed stream so clients receive turn lifecycle and delta events while the mission is still running, without weakening validation, authorization or cancellation.

results.boundary: Core ACP SSE transport only; no dependency, Commercial, Minijinja, release, harvest, Windows or credential change

acceptance.cargo test --offline --locked -p susi --: 2 passed, 0 failed; susi-gawd-a2a 3347/3347 shipped Rust lines
acceptance.cargo local-workflow check: passed; 145 test binaries, 0 failed; format 3.6s, clippy 12.2s, test build 20.7s, tests 57.6s, doc-tests 2.6s; total 76.0s

results.coverage: The callback-backed engine path delivers turn_started and message_delta before a deliberately blocked executor is released; the HTTP route preflights malformed/request-validation failures as application/json and sends valid turns through a bounded 16-frame SSE channel with backpressure.
limitations: A client disconnect stops frame delivery but does not add a new transport-level cancellation signal beyond the existing ACP session/cancel contract.
